signatures.description: Implement RFC 9807 OPAQUE augmented PAKE end to end in Node: OPRF blind/evaluate/finalize with the twist, randomized-password envelope derivation, KE1/KE2/KE3/KE4 message flow, the 3DH AKE sharing the exact same Diffie-Hellman operand ordering on both sides, and HMAC transcript binding over all prior messages. The hard parts are the exact transcript hashing order, the Derive-Secret label key schedule, and keeping the client key-recovery- and pre-computation-resistant property that a malicious server cannot test a password guess offline without a full AKE exchange. Include negative tests for swapped key-schedule labels, replay of a stale KE1, reflection of a server message back to itself, and a wrong-password KE2 that must fail MAC verification without revealing whether the OPRF evaluation was valid.
